CHOOSE BY WORKFLOW

Three ways to make the decision.

01

Sesami is a strong candidate when your agency wants an SDK and control over the booking experience. Set aside time to assess the implementation and maintenance work alongside the monthly subscription.

02

For a small live store, compare Sesami Small with Cowlendar's paid tiers and five-booking free plan. Sesami's free development plan is for building and testing, not an ongoing free live-store offer.

03

For group services or multiple locations, price Sesami at the tier that includes those needs. A larger retail operation may value its resource model and architecture support; a simpler merchant may prefer Cowlendar's common feature set.

SEE THE PRODUCT

Sesami, in its own words and screens.

This product image comes from Sesami’s official Shopify listing. Use the live demo and documentation to confirm your particular setup.

View the official listing ↗

Before you switch, test these four things.

  1. Recreate a real booking. Include duration, buffer time, capacity and the assigned person or resource.
  2. Trigger a conflict. Block the same time in a connected calendar and verify the storefront response.
  3. Follow the money. Make a test payment, then cancel and check how the booking and refund are handled separately.
  4. Protect upcoming appointments. Confirm the import method with support, reconcile future bookings, and switch only after the new flow passes.
